findings.finding: The partial-map oracle description did not explicitly exclude assignment at an unattained alphabet label. Statewise agreement alone would leave arbitrary assignments there and defeat greatest-map uniqueness on the two-label alphabet.
findings.resolution: Section 7.4 explicitly requires undefined at every unattained label and pointwise agreement wherever defined, then compares with the unique greatest accepted partial map.

findings.finding: The irrelevant-refinement row described only relabeling, while the executable control introduces extra distinctions that still leave pass/fail states together.
findings.resolution: Section 8 now distinguishes a refinement separating every conflicting pair in the queried fibre from one retaining such a pair.

findings.finding: SVR-R019 could be read as requiring every diagnostic outcome to retain a collision witness, including determined or unattained queries.
findings.resolution: SVR-R019 now applies explicitly to a reported obstruction.
